items.title_orig: Remember the bootleg section at the CD store back in the day? Why were they so expensive?
items.article_text:
Was just listening to some music from my youth, Nine Inch Nails. It was making me have some fond memories of my mom buying me a CD every once in a while at Camelot Music at the mall. 
 I'd be all excited reading the little booklet in the car. I think she only had a cassette player in her car, plus she didn't want to hear my music anyhow, so I'd be all excited to get home. 
 Haven't thought about it in years, but made me remember that they had a bootleg section. My mom wouldn't buy me those because they were like $50. They looked SO AWESOME. Always felt like I was missing out. Eventually I used some birthday money or something to buy a Nirvana live "bootleg". It was awful! I think somebody literally snuck a cassette tape recorder into a concert under their coat and kept it under their coat
